- I clicked at (32, 34)

When I clicked at (25, 27), no square moved. This is strange. Maybe the square at (40-41, 15-16) is too far from (25, 27)?
Or maybe the mechanic changed. Let me think...

- (40-41, 15-16) - unchanged
- (55-56, 46-47) - unchanged
- (56-57, 15-16) - unchanged

Hmm, maybe the mechanic is: clicking on a square moves it. When I clicked at (32, 34), I was clicking near the square at (37-38, 34-35), but not on it. But the square still moved. So maybe the mechanic is: clicking near a square moves it.
But clicking at (25, 27) didn't move any square. The closest square is at (31-32, 33-34), which is about 6-8 cells away. Maybe there's a distance threshold.
Actually, let me reconsider. Maybe the mechanic is: clicking ON a square moves it. When I clicked at (32, 34), I was clicking on the square at (37-38, 34-35)? No, (32, 34) is not in the range (37-38, 34-35).
